strategies.name: SMA Crossover
strategies.description: Long when the fast moving average is above the slow one. The classic trend filter.

strategies.name: MACD × RSI
strategies.description: MACD above its signal line, confirmed by RSI above a floor. Momentum with a quality check.

strategies.name: Donchian Breakout
strategies.description: Turtle-style: buy a new N-day high, exit on an M-day low.

strategies.name: RSI Mean Reversion
strategies.description: Buy when RSI is oversold, sell once it recovers past the exit level.

strategies.name: VWAP Reversion
strategies.description: Buy when price stretches below rolling VWAP by a band, exit back at VWAP.

strategies.name: Bollinger Breakout
strategies.description: Enter on a close outside the band, exit on a return to the mid-line.

strategies.name: Buy & Hold
strategies.description: Fully invested the whole time. Every strategy is measured against this.
